displayed author, visible publish date, capture time and query

acceptanceMatrix.pass: Visible institution sign, unambiguous architecture cue or post-level location corroborates Shanghai Chinese Orchestra at Xinhua Road 336.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Programme-only, performance interior, caption-only address, generic orchestra content or an unverified nearby venue.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: A visible numbered Building 6, 7, 8 or retained-volume label co-occurs with at least two stable exterior controls that can be compared to a candidate footprint.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Building number mentioned only in caption, facade without locatable controls, or a numbered room rather than building.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: A continuous exterior sequence or single broad view establishes compound boundary and distinguishes at least one included member from an adjacent non-member or road edge.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Isolated facade, montage jump, aerial image without source/provenance, or assumed boundary from proximity.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: The same-subject sequence visibly connects an entrance, curb/sidewalk/asphalt edge and a readable Xinhua Road or Fahuazhen Road control.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Road name only in caption, interior entrance, road centerline with hidden edge, or an unrelated street frontage.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: At least two fixed exterior controls, such as a corner, gate, wall end, road bend or neighboring distinct volume, support comparison to one candidate way without claiming survey precision.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Single perspective image, vegetation-obscured outline, crop without endpoints, or map screenshot without scale/provenance.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: The material gives a clear subject-specific facade, entrance or roof cue tied to an accepted member set; it may become a future Hero/Identity reference only after authoritative membership closes.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Decorative plaza, wayfinding, branded text, bench, planter, paving or a generic heritage-plus-modern composition.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: Visible post date is recorded and temporary barriers, tenant signage, construction and seasonal obstructions are separated from stable geometry.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Undated imagery treated as current measured truth.

qualificationAndDisposition.socialMediaLimit: Qualified social evidence may improve visual reference and identify a candidate for authoritative follow-up; it does not alone authorize formal OSM-way membership, map acceptance, Hero, Identity, MCP2, MCP3 or runtime promotion.
qualificationAndDisposition.reasonableSearchMissDefinition: All four query groups are attempted serially within the conservative budget and no result satisfies every required matrix row after duplicate, unrelated venue and caption-only rejection.
qualificationAndDisposition.beforeMainWindowConfirmation: No runtime-disable candidate, registry edit, runtime edit, model change or road/map mutation is authorized.
qualificationAndDisposition.afterMainWindowConfirmation: A runtime-disable candidate may be prepared for shanghai-orchestra only. It may remove the asset only from registry/runtime; all GLB, Blend, generator, evidence, tests, artifacts and Recovery/Hold materials remain preserved.
